title: boardwise declared footprint sample — one differential case input
description: A declared sample of one schematic Footprint field, read against the .epru record text it lives in. The input carries no expected projection: both runners look the value up in the archive's own uuid -> title table and emit boardwise.footprint-declared/1. `value` is the field verbatim and may be empty; there is no default spelling for an absent field.

text.x-meaning: The .epru record stream verbatim: {envelope}||{body}| lines, terminator optional on the last line.

value.x-meaning: The schematic Footprint field verbatim: a footprint name, a raw library id, or the empty string. Never omitted — an absent field and an empty one are two different statements.
